folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B393: research-wave routing and useful invention evidence
folds.body: The complete research-tech PLAN and STATUS were compared with this owner's existing Oct. 18 plan-reuse and CN follow-through sections. Those owner sections already preserve the substantive result: T6/T16 are pure planner/QA support, B1 has a bounded historical native result, B2 delivers seeded fixtures, B3 is an inspector design and B5 supplies conditional prompts. Earlier unmerged, started and not-dispatched lines remain dated history. A fixture is not naturally earned progression; a merged planning module is not a usable invention journey. The roadmap, actor hypothesis, trial and executable output remain separate. No further research wave, cleanup or runtime slice is selected. Current AD36 governs verification, AD42 makes human review optional, and the retired first-milestone gate does not return through an old prompt. The original provenance restoration remains meaningful; duplicated planning context is not a reason to strip per-entry source history.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B393: traveler asks can invite discovery
folds.body:
The full traveler-asks PLAN preserves Weibao's Amendment 1 over its original TA-A1 fresh-route filter. A ready, stretch or unknown request describes the character's present means and knowledge. It does not decide the world's possibility, the giver's appraisal or implementation coverage. An unknown request can create a reason to investigate through actual known clues; sealing protects the answer, not the whole discovery route. Missing indexed obtainability remains an authoring diagnostic. Disclose known content limits before the relevant commitment, without treating a missing game route as an in-world prohibition.

Keep the useful TA-A3/A4 contract ideas: saved terms and generation/table revision must survive their selected compatibility policy; new draws cannot silently rewrite an existing person's goal. Current compatibility decisions qualify the old blanket demand to retain every revision-1 record. Giver terms follow actual means, observable appraisal and the agreed offer, rather than reading the player's private discovery state. Later projections do not reprice escrow. Template, season, quantity, quality, service, mixture, teaching, repeat and grade variants remain useful options, not a requirement to build all ask families. TA1's report is a dated delivery reference, not a fresh review of its runtime. AD33 still deprioritizes NPC-heavy generation, AD42 does not make play feedback a mandatory stop, and no new Village depth is selected here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B393: source foundations do not supply fictional authority
folds.body:
Both complete source maps and the integrated report retain the same useful boundary: a fictional System needs actual issuer, observation, offer, adjudication, grant and revocation consumers. Shared software primitives do not supply those fictional powers by name. SM01–SM14 and SS01–SS12 describe bounded Oct. 11 source inspection, not current behavior or a universal prerequisites list. Their overlapping maps are historical viewpoints of one seam, not two service implementations. New promises need their selected actual consumer, state owner and durable publication path. Native random paths, command-seed commitment, event guarantees and creation-time box outcomes are distinct; none establishes universal determinism, generic pity or isolated RNG streams.

Retain the proposed work-ledger chain: funded commission, actual completion, one durable claim, earned point expenditure, useful changed function and a second real task. It can be selected independently of random starts, world creation, general NPC planning or a universal quest shop. Fixed preservation and an ordinary-to-extraordinary bridge can likewise be independent slices. Owner versus holder, authority versus learned skill, provider loss versus permanent gift and actor-safe knowledge versus author truth remain separate. Read-only quest cards cannot issue or settle an offer. The proposed repeated-claim, insufficient-input, failed-write, reachable-interface and persistence cases are not executed tests. The report's 36 leaves, 59 variants and 114 specified cases describe its own retained ledger; this map review does not claim a fresh semantic review of every linked leaf. No implementation, source acquisition or additional authority is created.
